# Quantity Surveyor

> A portable, MIT-licensed AI agent skill for construction quantity take-off, estimating and commercial cost control, for new buildings, renovations, construction work packages and associated site works.

Published by MuscleOtter. Current release: 2.0.2. Skill identifier: quantity-surveyor. Canonical repository: MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor. Claude, Codex and open-model hosts can use the same instructions; tools and accuracy depend on the host/model. Huge-drawing-set accuracy has not been measured. The historical synthetic rubric score is not an accuracy percentage or a version 2 benchmark.

## Start

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/README.md): Purpose, downloads and quick setup check.
- [Install](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/INSTALL.md): Nontechnical installation and name-change migration.
- [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/FAQ.md): Direct answers about capabilities, models, cost, privacy and evidence.
- [Compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): Host capabilities and unverified paths.

- [Features](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/FEATURES.md): Inputs, operations, deliverables and capability limits for every workflow.
- [Example requests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): Practical task prompts and what to attach.

- [Claude guidance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/CLAUDE.md): Installation, update/storage boundaries and an unexecuted host-validation checklist.

## Instructions and evidence

- [Core skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/skills/quantity-surveyor/SKILL.md): Routing to task-specific references.
- [Complete instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/llms-full.txt): Generated skill, references, templates and license in one document.
- [Large drawing sets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/DRAWING-SETS.md): Scope, failure modes and proposed validation plan.
- [Research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/RESEARCH.md): Pinned public reference projects, lessons and limitations.
- [Evaluation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MuscleOtter/quantity-surveyor/main/docs/EVALUATION.md): Historical evidence and version 2 test boundaries.
